points.point: Apple will not meet the revenue guidance it provided for the March quarter, due to COVID-19
points.quote: we do not expect to meet the revenue guidance we provided for the March quarter due to two main factors
paraphrases: Apple said it will not meet the revenue guidance it gave for the March quarter because of COVID-19 disruptions.
Apple withdrew/cut its March-quarter revenue outlook, citing the coronavirus impact.
The company now expects to fall short of its previously issued March-quarter revenue guidance.
decoys: Apple reaffirmed its revenue guidance for the March quarter despite the COVID-19 outbreak.
Apple withdrew its revenue guidance for the December quarter due to COVID-19.

points.point: Worldwide iPhone supply will be temporarily constrained because manufacturing partners are ramping up more slowly than anticipated
points.quote: worldwide iPhone supply will be temporarily constrained
paraphrases: Worldwide iPhone supply will be temporarily constrained as manufacturing partners ramp up more slowly than expected.
iPhone supply shortages, driven by a slower-than-expected factory ramp outside Hubei, will weigh on near-term shipments.
Apple flagged a temporary iPhone supply shortfall due to delays in the China manufacturing ramp-up.
decoys: Apple said iPhone supply has fully normalized and is no longer constrained.
Apple said iPad supply will be temporarily constrained due to the factory ramp.

points.point: Demand in China has been affected: Apple stores and many partner stores closed or operated with reduced hours and low traffic
points.quote: All of our stores in China and many of our partner stores have been closed.
paraphrases: Apple said demand in China has been hurt as stores remain closed or operating with reduced hours and low traffic.
Most Apple retail and partner stores in China were shut, weighing on near-term demand.
China demand for Apple products has softened amid store closures and low customer traffic.
decoys: Apple said demand in China has fully recovered as all stores have reopened normally.
Apple said demand in Japan has been affected by store closures and reduced traffic.

points.point: Outside of China, customer demand has remained strong and in line with expectations
points.quote: Outside of China, customer demand across our product and service categories has been strong to date and in line with our expectations.
paraphrases: Demand outside of China has remained strong and in line with expectations.
Ex-China, customer demand across Apple's product and service categories stayed healthy.
Apple said sales trends outside China were robust and matched prior expectations.
decoys: Demand outside of China has weakened and fallen short of expectations.
Demand within China has remained strong and in line with expectations.

points.point: Apple will provide more information on the impact during its next earnings call in April, without issuing new specific guidance now
points.quote: The situation is evolving, and we will provide more information during our next earnings call in April.
paraphrases: Apple said it will share more details on the financial impact during its April earnings call.
No updated guidance was given; Apple will address the impact on the next earnings call in April.
Apple plans to provide further updates at its earnings call in April as the situation evolves.
decoys: Apple provided updated specific revenue guidance for the March quarter today.
Apple said it will provide more information during its next earnings call in July.
